title: filter: blur() - Filters - Tailwind CSS
content_text: FILTERS filter: blur() Utilities for applying blur filters to an element. Class Styles blur-xs filter: blur(var(--blur-xs)); /* 4px */ blur-sm filter: blur(var(--blur-sm)); /* 8px */ blur-md filter: blur(var(--blur-md)); /* 12px */ blur-lg filter: blur(var(--blur-lg)); /* 16px */ blur-xl filter: blur(var(--blur-xl)); /* 24px */ blur-2xl filter: blur(var(--blur-2xl)); /* 40px */ blur-3xl filter: blur(var(--blur-3xl)); /* 64px */ blur-none filter: ; blur-() filter: blur(var()); blur-[] filter: blur(); EXAMPLES Basic example Use utilities like blur-sm and blur-lg to blur an element: blur-none blur-sm blur-lg blur-2xl Using a custom value Use the blur-[] syntax to set the blur based on a completely custom value: For CSS variables, you can also use the blur-() syntax: This is just a shorthand for blur-[var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix a filter: blur() utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above: Learn more about using variants in the variants documentation. Customizing your theme Use the --blur-* theme variables to customize the blur utilities in your project: @theme { --blur-2xs: 2px; } Now the blur-2xs utility can be used in your markup: Learn more about customizing your theme in the theme documentation. filter brightness
